raw.query: WITH expected(model, tier) AS (VALUES ('arima','dynamo'),('kalman','dynamo'),('prophet','dynamo'),('constant','dynamo'),('ewma','classical'),('holt_winters','classical'),('naive','classical'),('chronos','foundation'),('timesfm','foundation'),('toto','foundation')), inv AS (SELECT forecast_model AS model, COUNT(DISTINCT source_path) AS current_image_sources FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE experiment='predictors' AND kind='K10' AND source_path ILIKE '%images%' AND is_current AND superseded_by IS NULL GROUP BY forecast_model), br AS (SELECT model, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('mode',mode,'resolution',resolution,'rows',n_rows,'origins',n_origins,'wape',wape) ORDER BY mode,resolution) AS per_window FROM (SELECT model, mode, resolution, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT origin) AS n_origins, SUM(ABS(y_true-point))/NULLIF(SUM(ABS(y_true)),0) AS wape FROM provenance.v_forecast_thesis_corpus WHERE variate='images' GROUP BY model,mode,resolution) x GROUP BY model) SELECT e.model,e.tier,COALESCE(i.current_image_sources,0) AS current_image_sources,COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(br.per_window),0) AS window_breakdowns,br.per_window FROM expected e LEFT JOIN inv i USING(model) LEFT JOIN br USING(model) ORDER BY e.tier,e.model
raw.observed: ARIMA, Kalman, Prophet, and constant each have 0 current image sources and 0 per-window breakdowns; the current image corpus contains only EWMA, Holt-Winters, naive, Chronos, TimesFM, and Toto.
raw.claimed: Run through the same protocol on the image signal (shipped defaults; the constant predictor reproduces the naive baseline's WAPE exactly), all four sit at or below the classical frontier and none reaches the foundation-model level
raw.evidence: The owning current inventory and row-level forecast corpus contain no image-signal observations or WAPE values for any of Dynamo's four predictors, so neither their frontier placement nor constant-naive equality can be verified.
raw.fix: Add current, non-superseded image-signal outputs for ARIMA, Kalman, Prophet, and constant under shipped defaults, including per-resolution/per-origin metrics; then verify constant-naive WAPE equality and compare all four against the classical and foundation tiers.
